description: DORA Fault Injection Dataset - 100 Realistic Data Pipeline Faults

faults.title: Invalid materialized value in dbt_project.yml
faults.description: Typo in materialized configuration causes compilation error
faults.injection: Change materialized: 'table' to materialized: 'tabel' in models config
faults.expected_error_pattern: not a valid value for materialized
fix_steps: Correct the typo 'tabel' to 'table' in dbt_project.yml
Run dbt compile to verify the fix
Re-run the failed dbt task

faults.title: Undefined variable in dbt model
faults.description: Using a var() that is not defined in dbt_project.yml
faults.injection: Add where order_date >= '{{ var('start_date') }}' but don't define start_date
fix_steps: Add the missing variable to the vars section in dbt_project.yml
Alternatively pass the variable via --vars command line argument
Verify the variable name spelling

faults.title: Calling non-existent PostgreSQL function
faults.description: SQL query references a function that doesn't exist in the database
fix_steps: Check if the function exists in the database
Create the missing function or use an alternative built-in function
Verify function name and argument types match

faults.title: SQL syntax error - missing comma
faults.description: Missing comma in SELECT clause causes parse error
faults.injection: Remove comma between first_name and last_name columns
fix_steps: Review SQL syntax near the error position
Add missing comma between column names
Test the query with dbt compile

faults.title: ref() to non-existent model
faults.description: Model references another model that doesn't exist
fix_steps: Check if the referenced model exists in the project
Correct the model name in the ref() call
Ensure the model is enabled and in the correct directory

faults.title: Invalid schema.yml test configuration
faults.description: Schema test has invalid YAML syntax
faults.injection: Add bad YAML indentation in tests section
fix_steps: Fix YAML indentation in schema.yml
Validate YAML syntax with a linter
Run dbt compile to verify

faults.title: Misspelled SQL keyword
faults.description: SELECT misspelled as SELCT causes parse error
fix_steps: Fix the misspelled SQL keyword
Review query for other typos
Run dbt compile to verify

faults.title: Circular dependency between models
faults.description: Two models reference each other creating a cycle
faults.injection: Add a ref('fct_order_summary') to stg_orders creating a cycle
fix_steps: Identify the circular dependency chain using dbt docs
Refactor models to break the cycle
Consider using ephemeral models or intermediate tables

faults.title: Source column dropped - schema drift
faults.description: Upstream source table removed a column used by dbt model
faults.injection: Drop email column from raw.customers table
fix_steps: Update the dbt model to not reference the dropped column
Add schema tests to detect future column changes
Coordinate with source system owners for change management

faults.title: Data type mismatch in join condition
faults.description: Joining on columns of different data types
faults.injection: Change customer_id column type from INT to VARCHAR
fix_steps: Add explicit type casting in the join condition
Use customer_id::INT or CAST(customer_id AS INT)
Align data types across source and target tables

faults.title: Duplicate key violation on incremental model
faults.description: Incremental model produces duplicate primary keys
faults.injection: Insert duplicate order_id into source table
fix_steps: Add deduplication logic using row_number() or DISTINCT
Check source data for duplicate records
Use on_schema_change=sync_all_columns properly for incremental

faults.title: Foreign key violation in test
faults.description: dbt relationship test fails due to orphaned records
fix_steps: Identify orphaned records in the source data
Add referential integrity tests to catch issues early
Clean up bad data or handle orphans in the model

faults.title: NULL value in NOT NULL column
faults.description: Source data contains NULL in a column marked not_null in dbt tests
fix_steps: Use COALESCE to handle NULL values in the model
Add not_null dbt test to detect issues early
Investigate why source has NULL values

faults.title: Insufficient database permissions
faults.description: dbt user lacks permission to create tables in schema
faults.injection: Revoke CREATE privilege on staging schema
fix_steps: Grant CREATE and USAGE privileges on the schema
Grant SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on tables
Verify permissions with information_schema queries

faults.title: Query timeout on large table
faults.description: dbt model exceeds statement timeout during full refresh
fix_steps: Increase statement_timeout for long-running queries
Add indexes on frequently filtered/joined columns
Use incremental models for large tables
Optimize query with EXPLAIN ANALYZE

faults.title: Deadlock between concurrent dbt runs
faults.description: Two dbt jobs running concurrently deadlock on table access
faults.injection: Run two dbt jobs that access tables in opposite order
fix_steps: Ensure consistent table access order across models
Use lower isolation level if acceptable
Add retry logic for deadlock errors
Serialize conflicting dbt jobs in Airflow

faults.title: Disk full - no space left
faults.description: Database runs out of disk space during large dbt run
faults.injection: Fill up disk space with temp tables
fix_steps: Clean up old data and temporary tables
Run VACUUM to reclaim storage space
Increase disk space or add additional storage
Monitor disk usage and set up alerts

faults.title: Database connection refused
faults.description: dbt cannot connect to PostgreSQL database
fix_steps: Verify database host and port configuration
Check if the database server is running
Verify network connectivity and firewall rules
Check for connection pool exhaustion
